claim_ceiling: Boundary policy is identified as a proof obligation. No variational derivation is closed.

boundary_rows.issue: Einstein-Hilbert variation contains boundary contributions unless the action principle and boundary conditions are explicitly specified.
A GHY-style term or equivalent boundary handling may be required for a well-posed metric variation under Dirichlet-like boundary conditions.
Scalar EOM rehearsal requires integration-by-parts rules and explicit boundary behavior for delta_Psi.
If GMUT later introduces F(Psi)R, derivative couplings, or B_Psi-like structures, generalized boundary terms may be needed.
No term may be dropped as a boundary term without a declared class of variations and boundary conditions.

failure_conditions: Claiming a scalar EOM while boundary conditions are unstated.
Claiming metric variation while the Einstein-Hilbert boundary term is unresolved.
Dropping total derivatives without a source-bound boundary rule.
Using boundary assumptions to close conservation or null recovery.
next_phase_requirements: Separate metric boundary terms from scalar field boundary terms.
State whether the phase is rehearsing Dirichlet, Neumann, mixed, compact-support, or no-boundary conditions.
Keep any nonminimal coupling boundary issue open until a separate action exists.
